This pull request comes from a fork, so Mintlify won't build a preview until someone with write access approves commit `468339f`.

[Approve preview](https://github.com/mcp-use/mcp-use/pull/2969/checks?check_run_id=122890343775)

<!-- close-python-prs -->
Thanks for taking the time to contribute. Our focus right now is on the TypeScript SDK, so we're limiting Python PRs to fixes for concrete problems that contributors have run into firsthand. We're automatically closing new Python PRs for now. If this was prompted by something you hit in practice, please reply here with what you were doing when it came up and how to reproduce it. A maintainer can reopen the PR and take another look. Reopened PRs are left open for manual review.
